C1.worst_defect: The hero and the 'What it does today' list speak to the freelancer (plugin 0.3.0, Vendure server, Postgres/Node requirements). Nothing tells the owner in one line whether the staff can sell tomorrow and who has to set what up first. On the phone, the header shows only Docs and Live demo; Quick start and At the till are hidden behind a chevron.

C2.worst_defect: The offline story contradicts itself. The Troubleshooting text says 'everything at the till works offline except customer search'. At the till and Limitations say a reload needs the connection, and unsent sales are lost if site data is cleared. The search result for 'offline' surfaces the reassuring line first.
C2.where: troubleshooting text (search API hit for 'offline') vs at-the-till 'If the internet drops' and limitations

C3.worst_defect: Quick start is nine developer steps (npm install, TallyPosPlugin, tsx migrations, tokenMethod, CORS_ORIGINS, a tax strategy table). There is no owner-level summary of how long it takes or what the freelancer must hand over to staff (till URL, logins). There are no scanner or receipt-printer setup steps beyond the browser print dialog.

C4.worst_defect: Troubleshooting asks counter staff to 'copy the refused line from this till's sync log, and match its errorCode' (e.g. register_session_already_open), which is not usable between customers. At the till says 'Tap your name in the bar', but the bar in the screenshots shows only a 'C' avatar circle.

C5.worst_defect: The closure-screen screenshot has wide empty gaps between Counted / Expected / Exact, so it looks unfinished. A lone 'Park' label floats centred above the cart in the hero till image. The 404 is a heading and three buttons over an empty page.

C6.worst_defect: The sticky 'On this page' bar names the first section ('Open the register', 'Open Notifications', '0.3.0 (2026-10-06)') before the reader has scrolled to it. The phone hero till image shrinks to two product cards and tells little.

C7.worst_defect: og-image.png crops the till screenshot mid-row at the bottom, so the 'Add charge' button is cut off. The 404 page has no JSON-LD (minor).

overall_worst.defect: The site gives two answers to the owner's key question 'what happens when the internet drops'. Troubleshooting says 'everything at the till works offline except customer search'. At the till and Limitations say a reload or closed tab needs the connection, and unsent sales can be lost.
overall_worst.where: troubleshooting text vs at-the-till 'If the internet drops' / limitations
overall_worst.fix: Make the Troubleshooting line say the same thing as At the till: 'Selling works offline as long as the till's tab stays open; do not reload or close it until the connection is back.' Put that sentence in the home 'What it does today' offline item too.
